configurePresets.name: linux
configurePresets.description: Used inside the tools/dev/ container. Triplet auto-detected (arm64-linux on Apple Silicon, x64-linux elsewhere). Overlay triplets in tools/dev/triplets/ force VCPKG_BUILD_TYPE=release on deps to halve disk + time on cold builds — see tools/dev/triplets/README.md.

configurePresets.name: linux-tsan
configurePresets.description: ThreadSanitizer build for the dev container — regression gate for PJSIP-worker-thread vs main-thread races (`make test-tsan`). Separate binaryDir; vcpkg populates its own vcpkg_installed there (fast via the binary cache, but ~extra disk).
